args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release previously healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east updated due to an orchestrator error) and was retried successfully. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all three regions with an error rate of 0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed without identifying and fixing the root cause.

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout (INC-0001 is open), so no retry was needed. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east updated due to an orchestrator error), so I retried and it completed in all regions.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the failure, the rollback mitigation (including the partial failure and retry), and the post-rollback health status. The on-call engineer has been paged.
